title: Speaking — Remembering details
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on remembering details.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
What details are you good at remembering?
Do you use any tools to remember names or dates?

part2.topic: Describe an occasion when remembering a detail proved important.
part2.closing: and explain why it mattered on that occasion.

questions: How has the availability of reminders affected expectations about memory?
Which types of information are still worth memorising at school?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to remembering details?
